units.source_text: “我被人欺骗过，而且是骨肉至亲的欺骗。

en.t: “I have been deceived by people, and by my own flesh and blood at that.

units.source_text: 他们在我父亲面前装好人，可是父亲刚一去世，他们就变成了无法饶恕的坏蛋。

en.t: They pretended to be good people in front of my father, but as soon as he died, they turned into unforgivable villains.

units.source_text: 他们对我的侮辱与伤害，我从儿时起一直背负到今天，大概要背负到死吧。

en.t: The insults and injuries they inflicted on me, I have carried from childhood until today, and I will probably carry them until I die.

units.source_text: 因为，我至死也不会忘记的。

en.t: Because I will not forget them even when I die.

units.source_text: 但是，我一直没有去报复。

en.t: But I have never taken revenge.

units.source_text: 因为，我现在做的事是超越个人的爱恨情仇的，

en.t: Because what I am doing now goes beyond personal love, hatred, resentment, and grievance,

units.source_text: 我不仅憎恶他们，而且由此学会了憎恶他们所代表的那类人。

en.t: I not only hate them; through this, I have also learned to hate the kind of people they represent.

units.source_text: 我连一句慰藉的话也说不出来了。

en.t: I could not even say a single word of comfort.
1. Packhorse: a horse used for carrying loads.
